markets.rules_primary: If a social media ban for children has been enacted in the European Union after Issuance and before Oct 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
Enactment requires completion of all constitutional and legal requirements for the legislation to become binding law.

A social media ban for children means an EU-level measure prohibiting people below a stated age of 18 or lower from holding or accessing accounts on a class of social media platforms across the European Union. Parental consent must not bypass the prohibition for the barred age group; a separate consent-based tier for older children does not disqualify it.

The following do NOT constitute enactment:

Passage by only some required bodies
Provisional passage
Non-binding resolutions
Draft orders

Age verification, parental consent, platform safety requirements, content restrictions and Member-State-only laws do NOT qualify on their own. The prohibition must have legal effect, including completion of required waiting periods or implementation; adoption or publication alone does NOT qualify.

Enactment occurs when all requirements are completed, regardless of pending judicial challenges.

Note: This event was issued before the September 14, 2026 amendment to the LAW Contract, so that amendment does not apply. To be clear, a law must take legal effect before this event’s deadline; a law enacted before the deadline whose effective date falls on or after it does not satisfy the Payout Criterion.

A social media ban for children means an EU-level measure prohibiting people below a stated age of 18 or lower from holding or accessing accounts on a class of social media platforms across the European Union. Parental consent must not bypass the prohibition for the barred age group; a separate consent-based tier for older children does not disqualify it.

The following do NOT constitute enactment:

Passage by only some required bodies
Provisional passage
Non-binding resolutions
Draft orders

Age verification, parental consent, platform safety requirements, content restrictions and Member-State-only laws do NOT qualify on their own. The prohibition must have legal effect, including completion of required waiting periods or implementation; adoption or publication alone does NOT qualify.

Enactment occurs when all requirements are completed, regardless of pending judicial challenges.

Note: This event was issued before the September 14, 2026 amendment to the LAW Contract, so that amendment does not apply. To be clear, a law must take legal effect before this event’s deadline; a law enacted before the deadline whose effective date falls on or after it does not satisfy the Payout Criterion.

markets.rules_primary: If the number of Trump Cabinet members who leave or announce they will leave is at least 2 after Issuance and before Jan 1, 2028, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
For purposes of this Contract, the Cabinet includes the heads of the 15 government agencies in the Cabinet as of Issuance, as well as the Administrator of the EPA, the President’s Chief of Staff, Director of National Intelligence, Director of OMB, Director of CIA, United States Trade Representative, Ambassador to the UN, Chair of the Council of Economic Advisers, Administrator of the SBA, and Director of OSTP. Acting roles are not included.

Each person who leaves one of these positions, or announces they will leave it, after Issuance counts once. A person’s announcement of their intent to leave and their departure count as one occurrence, at the earlier of the two. The President announcing that a member of the Cabinet will leave the Cabinet also qualifies.

A person who begins serving in one of these positions after Issuance, including Stephen Miller as Chief of Staff, counts if they later leave it. Moving directly from one of these positions to another does not count.

A leave of absence does not constitute leaving the position. Leaving office as a result of death is not encompassed by the Payout Criterion.

markets.rules_primary: If the number of U.S. states that enact a new general minimum wage increase is at least 1 in 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
A state qualifies upon enactment during 2027 of a statute or voter-approved measure that raises that state's general minimum wage above the rate prior law would have produced. Enactment requires the governor's signature, a veto override, or the measure becoming law without signature. A ballot measure qualifies on approval by voters at an election held during 2027. The effective date may fall in 2027 or later.

A state also qualifies by accelerating or raising an already-scheduled step, by changing an indexing formula so that the rate comes out higher, or by setting a general minimum wage for the first time. Each state counts once however many measures it enacts, and stays counted if the measure is later repealed, superseded or enjoined.

The following do NOT count:
An automatic inflation or cost-of-living adjustment under existing law
An increase enacted before 2027, whichever year it takes effect
A measure that lowers, freezes, caps or preempts a minimum wage
A measure raising only a sub-population rate, such as tipped, youth, agricultural or public contractor wages, without raising the general rate
An executive order, agency rule, wage board order or court decision
A city, county or other local ordinance
A bill passed by one or both chambers but not enacted, and a measure placed on a 2028 or later ballot

Washington, D.C. and the U.S. territories are NOT states. Neither the January 1, 2027 increases in states that index to inflation nor the already-enacted 2027 steps in Michigan, Alaska, Virginia and Rhode Island count.

markets.rules_primary: If the US SPR level is above 300 million barrels before October 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary: The US SPR level is the value on Table 1 of the U.S. Energy Information Administration's Weekly Petroleum Status Report (U.S. Petroleum Balance Sheet), row “Strategic Petroleum Reserve (SPR)”, under the Current Week column. The market resolves to Yes if any Weekly Petroleum Status Report released after Issuance and before the date in the market's title shows that value above 300 million barrels. A report released on or after that date does not count, even if the week it covers ended before it. The value as first published for each week governs; later revisions are not counted.

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the person announces their candidacy.

markets.rules_secondary:
Only a public announcement by the person or their official campaign that they are running counts, and it must be reported by a Source Agency. A run for any party's nomination, or as an independent or third-party candidate, counts.

Filing paperwork without a public announcement, such as an FEC statement of candidacy or ballot petitions
Forming an exploratory committee, or saying they are interested in or considering a run
Reports about their plans that do not come from them or their campaign
An announcement made before Issuance

A person who announces and later withdraws still resolves to YES.

An "endorsement" requires:
A clear, affirmative statement of support for candidate's election
The statement must be public (not private communications)
The endorsement must specifically reference the 2028 presidential election or be clearly in context of the 2028 presidential election
The endorsement must come directly from Donald Trump or through official channels

The following scenarios would resolve to YES:
Donald Trump states "I endorse candidate for [office]"
Donald Trump states "I support candidate" with clear reference to the 2028 presidential election
Donald Trump states "I'm voting for candidate" publicly
Donald Trump states "candidate has my full support" for the 2028 presidential election
Donald Trump appears at campaign events specifically to endorse
Donald Trump releases official endorsement through their organization
Donald Trump allows their name/image to be used in candidate's campaign materials

Statements of obvious sarcasm (or which are immediately followed by clarifications that Donald Trump is joking) are NOT encompassed by the Payout Criterion.

The Contract shall resolve immediately upon confirmation of the first qualifying endorsement in the specified race. If multiple candidates are listed for a listed race and exactly one is endorsed, that candidate's strike resolves "Yes" at $1.00 and all other named-candidate strikes resolve "No." If multiple are endorsed, each endorsed candidate's strike resolves "Yes" at a value of ($1.00 / N) rounded down to the nearest $0.01. 

If no endorsement occurs before expiration, the "No one" strike resolves "Yes" at $1.00 and all named-candidate strikes resolve "No."

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the endorsement occurs.
markets.rules_primary: If the Democratic Socialists of America (DSA) national organization publicly endorses Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez in the 2028 presidential election, including the Democratic primaries before Mar 1, 2028, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
An endorsement requires a clear, affirmative statement of support for the candidate's election in the 2028 presidential election, including the Democratic primaries, made after Issuance and before Mar 1, 2028. The statement must be public (not private communications) and must specifically reference that race or be clearly in context of it. The endorsement must come directly from DSA or through its official channels.

The following scenarios would resolve to YES:
DSA states that it endorses the candidate for president
DSA states that it supports the candidate, with clear reference to the race
DSA releases an official endorsement through its national channels
DSA allows its name or logo to be used in the candidate's campaign materials

Positive comments without explicit support, or policy endorsements without a candidate endorsement, do not qualify. Ranking a candidate anything other than first in a ranked-choice process does not qualify, and publication of poll or ranked-choice results, whether national or chapter-level, is not itself an endorsement; only the resulting decision of the national organization qualifies. Social media endorsements count only from verified accounts, and likes or retweets alone do not constitute endorsement. Quote tweets with additional supportive commentary do count. Statements of obvious sarcasm, or which are immediately followed by clarifications that DSA is joking, are not encompassed by the Payout Criterion.

Only the Democratic Socialists of America (DSA) national organization satisfies the Payout Criterion, acting through its national governing bodies or processes and announced through DSA's national channels. Qualifying decisions include a resolution or vote of the DSA National Convention, a decision of the National Political Committee, and a binding vote of the national membership. An endorsement, chapter poll result, or statement of support from a local or state DSA chapter, caucus, or working group does not qualify unless the national organization adopts it.

A statement that a candidate has or will have DSA's endorsement qualifies if the only condition attached is that the candidate enter or remain in the race. A statement conditioned on anything else, such as winning a primary or adopting a policy position, does not.

The Contract shall resolve immediately upon confirmation of the first qualifying endorsement. If DSA endorses more than one listed candidate, each endorsed candidate's strike resolves Yes at a value of ($1.00 / N) rounded down to the nearest $0.01, and all non-endorsed named-candidate strikes resolve No. If no qualifying endorsement occurs before Mar 1, 2028, the "No one" strike resolves Yes and every named-candidate strike resolves No.

If a candidate withdraws from, suspends their campaign for, ceases to be a candidate in, declines to enter, or loses the primary or general election for the race before a qualifying endorsement of that candidate is confirmed, their strike may resolve to No in the sole discretion of the Exchange.
markets.title: Will the Democratic Socialists of America (DSA) national organization endorse Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez in the 2028 presidential election, including the Democratic primaries before Mar 1, 2028?

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if any component becomes impossible to occur (resolving to No) or all components have been satisfied (resolving to Yes).
markets.rules_primary: If ALL of the following occur: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez: announces a 2028 presidential run, Zohran Mamdani: endorses Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
For all outcomes in this market, AOC runs means Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez publicly announces, after Issuance and before Mar 1, 2028, that she is running for President of the United States in 2028, including a run for the Democratic nomination. The announcement must come from her or her official campaign. Filing paperwork with the Federal Election Commission without a public announcement, forming an exploratory committee, or saying she is considering a run does not count, and a run for any other office, including the U.S. Senate, does not count. AOC doesn't run means no such announcement occurs before Mar 1, 2028. An announced run counts even if she later withdraws.

Mamdani endorses a candidate means Zohran Mamdani makes a clear, public, affirmative statement of support for that candidate in the 2028 presidential election, including the Democratic primaries, after Issuance and before Mar 1, 2028, either himself or through his official accounts. Praise without explicit support does not count, including calling a candidate an inspiration, saying a candidate would be great at whatever office they seek, or urging someone to run. A statement that a candidate has or will have his endorsement counts if the only condition attached is that the candidate enter or remain in the race; a statement conditioned on anything else does not. Likes or reposts alone do not count; quote posts with supportive commentary do.

If AOC runs, "Mamdani endorses her" requires an endorsement of Ocasio-Cortez at any time before Mar 1, 2028, even if he endorsed someone else first, and "Mamdani doesn't endorse her" requires that he has not endorsed her before Mar 1, 2028.

If AOC doesn't run, endorsements of Ocasio-Cortez are disregarded, and only Mamdani's first qualifying endorsement of anyone else counts; the market naming that candidate resolves to Yes. If his first endorsement names more than one listed candidate at once, each of those markets resolves to Yes at a value of ($1.00 / N) rounded down to the nearest $0.01, where N counts only the listed candidates it names. If he makes no qualifying endorsement of anyone other than Ocasio-Cortez before Mar 1, 2028, "Mamdani endorses no one else" resolves to Yes. In these markets, Ocasio-Cortez is not a candidate for the Zohran Mamdani (ENDORSE) component, so an endorsement of her, including one conditioned only on her entering the race, does not trigger the ENDORSE provision that resolves a "No one" outcome to No upon the first qualifying endorsement of any candidate.

This is a combination market requiring ALL specified outcomes to occur for the contract to pay out. If ANY single component resolves to No or becomes impossible, the entire contract immediately resolves to No. Each component is resolved according to its corresponding Kalshi ruleset: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez (RUN), Zohran Mamdani (ENDORSE).

markets.rules_primary: If the U.S. goods and services deficit for calendar year 2027 is strictly above $500 billion dollars, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
The Underlying is the nominal goods and services balance on a balance-of-payments basis. It will not use the goods-only deficit, the advance goods report, the December monthly deficit, or inflation-adjusted trade data.

Because the agencies generally report the balance as a negative number, the market will use the absolute size of the deficit. For example, an annual trade balance of −$800.1 billion constitutes a trade deficit of $800.1 billion.

Resolution will use the first annual estimate published in the release covering December of 2027. Subsequent annual revisions will not be considered.

Resolution will use the first annual estimate published in the release covering December of 2027. Subsequent annual revisions will not be considered.

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early when its outcome is determined.
markets.rules_primary: If the number of Knesset seats held by the factions in Israel's next government is at least 45 when the Knesset approves it before Oct 28, 2027 (0 if it does not), then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
Israel's next government is the first one the Knesset elected on Oct 27, 2026 approves in a vote of confidence. A faction counts if it is part of that government's coalition: it signed a coalition agreement to join the government that was submitted to the Knesset before the vote, or one of its members is a minister when the Knesset approves the government or is appointed a deputy minister within 30 days after the vote. Factions that only support the government from outside the coalition or abstain do not count, including under a written support agreement. Seats are each faction's size in the Knesset on the day of the vote; later changes do not count.

If that Knesset dissolves before approving a government, or none is approved before Oct 28, 2027, the number of seats is 0.
markets.title: Will the number of Knesset seats held by the factions in Israel's next government be at least 45 when the Knesset approves it before Oct 28, 2027 (0 if it does not)?

markets.rules_secondary:
Rankings are determined by total seat count after the election.

Each member is counted once, for the party designation shown by the State of Mississippi. Events after the date of the general election, such as party switches, deaths, resignations, vacancies, appointments, special elections, and any decision by the Mississippi Senate to refuse to seat or to expel a member-elect, are disregarded. important_info.markdown:
**Important information:** 
We would like to clarify that this market will resolve on the GICS sector that S&P Global (S&P Dow Jones Indices / MSCI) assigns to OpenAI. GICS sector classifications are assigned at the company level based on a company's principal business activity, separately from S&P 500 index membership.

OpenAI does not need to be added to or be a member of the S&P 500 for this market to resolve — it resolves on the first GICS sector S&P Global assigns to OpenAI, whether or not OpenAI is a S&P 500 constituents.

To avoid further confusion, we have changed the titles of these events to “What sector will OpenAI be assigned to?”

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the law is enacted
markets.rules_primary: If legislation repealing the right-to-work law (2015 Wisconsin Act 1) is enacted in Wisconsin before Jan 1, 2028, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
Enactment requires completion of all constitutional and legal requirements for the legislation to become binding law.

Standard legislation requiring executive approval: final passage by all required legislative bodies, executive signature OR becoming law despite executive inaction OR successful veto override, and satisfaction of any required waiting periods
Legislation not requiring executive approval: final passage and completion of required waiting periods
Constitutional amendments: passage with required supermajorities and completion of ratification processes
Executive orders: official signature, publication in official government records, and legal effectiveness

The following do NOT constitute enactment:

Legislative passage without completed executive action
Passage by only some required bodies
Provisional passage
Non-binding resolutions
Draft orders

Enactment occurs when all requirements are completed, regardless of pending judicial challenges.

For this market, repealing the right-to-work law means legislation that eliminates the Wisconsin law created by 2015 Wisconsin Act 1 (Wis. Stat. 111.04 (3) and 947.20), which bars requiring union membership or the payment of union dues or fees as a condition of employment. A law that only exempts certain industries, workers or workplaces from that ban does NOT qualify.

Only legislation enacted by the Wisconsin Legislature after Issuance qualifies. A court ruling, executive order or agency action does NOT qualify.
markets.title: Will Wisconsin repeal its right-to-work law before Jan 1, 2028?

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the event occurs.
markets.rules_primary: If the White House officially announces that the James S. Brady Press Briefing Room will be converted into a swimming pool after Issuance and before Jan 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
Only reporting from the White House qualifies for the purposes of this market. Reports that merely reference prior publications (from before Issuance) do not qualify. Republishing of content originally produced by other sources (e.g., wire services) only qualifies if the content is hosted on the outlet's official platform and the outlet is clearly identified as the publishing entity.

The qualifying publication must announce a definite White House decision that the James S. Brady Press Briefing Room will be converted into a swimming pool, whether newly built or restored from the 1933 pool beneath its floor. It must appear on a White House channel, or be posted by the President himself, including on his own social media accounts. A decision that names a future start or completion date still qualifies.

The following do NOT count:
An image, rendering, mock-up or joke that does not itself state a definite decision
Saying the idea is under consideration, that options remain on the table, or that an announcement will come later
Announcing that the press corps, the briefings or the briefing room are moving, with no pool announced
A decision to restore the 1933 pool while the room keeps serving as the press briefing room
A renovation, demolition or study of the room that does not decide on a pool
A White House official describing what the President wants or prefers, rather than a decision
A White House statement carried only by a news outlet it was given to
A pool announced anywhere else at the White House
markets.title: Will the White House announce a briefing room swimming pool before Jan 1, 2027?

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the event occurs.
markets.rules_primary: If Waymo is operating commercial autonomous vehicle ride-hailing services available to the general public within Washington, DC before Jan 1, 2028, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
"Operating commercial services" means that members of the general public can download the Waymo app (or access Waymo through a partner app), request a ride with pickup and dropoff locations within Washington, DC, and receive autonomous vehicle service for a fee.

The service must be available to the general public without requiring special invitation codes, waitlist approval, or participation in testing programs, though geographic coverage within Washington, DC may be limited to certain areas. Services operating exclusively with safety drivers present do not satisfy the Payout Criterion; the service must offer fully autonomous rides (without a human safety driver) at least some of the time.

Examples that WOULD resolve to Yes:

Waymo launches public commercial service in any part of Washington, DC
Waymo expands from adjacent areas into Washington, DC limits
Waymo operates 24/7 service or limited hours service within Washington, DC
Waymo offers service through the Uber app to all users in Washington, DC
Service is geofenced to only certain neighborhoods but is public

Examples that would resolve to No:

Waymo only operates employee shuttles or closed testing in Washington, DC
Waymo only has an office or maintenance facility in Washington, DC
All Waymo vehicles in Washington, DC have safety drivers
Waymo is testing but not offering paid public rides
Service requires being on a waitlist or having a special code
Waymo announces plans to launch but hasn't started service by Jan 1, 2028
markets.title: Will Waymo operate ride-hailing in Washington, DC before Jan 1, 2028?

Only reporting from any of the Source Agencies qualifies for the purposes of this market. Reports that merely reference prior publications (from before Issuance) do not qualify. A qualifying call must be announced by a person or body with legal authority to call the election and must specify an actual polling date. Requests for an election, a dissolution resolution, or failure to nominate a First Minister without such a call do not qualify. markets.rules_primary: If the United States agrees to or announces the establishment of a national AI regulator before Jan 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
For this market, a qualifying establishment must be adopted through a law, executive order, regulation, or other binding official act, or unconditionally announced by the President, an authorized Cabinet official, or another authorized U.S. government body.

A new body or formally designated existing body qualifies only if a binding official action grants it primary nationwide, cross-sector AI rulemaking, licensing, supervisory, or enforcement authority comparable in substance to a national regulator, or if an unconditional official announcement commits to granting it such authority, including when that authority will take effect later. The body's name or form does not control: a council, office, standards body, or SRO qualifies if one identifiable body receives those powers. A body that only advises, coordinates, studies, tests, sets voluntary standards, conducts one-off reviews, or has only sector-specific authority does not qualify. Distributed sector-by-sector authority does not qualify.

markets.rules_primary: If the UK agrees to or announces a decision not to transfer sovereignty over Diego Garcia to Mauritius before Dec 1, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.

Changes to payments, the duration or terms of the UK's use of Diego Garcia, security provisions, implementation dates, or other treaty provisions do not qualify if Mauritius would still become sovereign over Diego Garcia.

markets.rules_primary: If Louise Haigh is the next to leave the Burnham Cabinet before Jan 1, 2028, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
A member leaves the Cabinet upon the qualifying announcement of their resignation, dismissal, removal, non-reappointment, or other formal cessation of Cabinet membership. A change of portfolio or position within the Cabinet alone does not count.

If two or more members leave on the same calendar date and the Source Agencies do not establish a clear chronological order, the tied member markets settle according to the Contract's split-settlement provisions. If no eligible member leaves during the specified period, all member markets resolve to No.

A temporary absence or leave where the member is expected to resume their Cabinet position does not count. Speculative or unconfirmed reports of a departure do not count. If the Prime Minister leaves office or the Cabinet is otherwise dissolved or wholly reconstituted before an individual member satisfies the Payout Criterion, all listed individual-member markets resolve to No.

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the law is enacted
markets.rules_primary: If legislation legalizing recreational marijuana is enacted in Texas before Jan 1, 2028, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
Enactment requires completion of all constitutional and legal requirements for the legislation to become binding law.

Standard legislation requiring executive approval: final passage by all required legislative bodies, executive signature OR becoming law despite executive inaction OR successful veto override, and satisfaction of any required waiting periods
Legislation not requiring executive approval: final passage and completion of required waiting periods
Constitutional amendments: passage with required supermajorities and completion of ratification processes
Executive orders: official signature, publication in official government records, and legal effectiveness

The following do NOT constitute enactment:

Legislative passage without completed executive action
Passage by only some required bodies
Provisional passage
Non-binding resolutions
Draft orders

Enactment occurs when all requirements are completed, regardless of pending judicial challenges.

For this market, legislation legalizing recreational marijuana means legislation that makes the possession or sale of marijuana by or to adults for non-medical use lawful under Texas law.

Legislation that only decriminalizes marijuana, expands medical marijuana, regulates hemp-derived THC products, or creates a cannabis regulatory board without making non-medical adult use lawful does NOT qualify.
markets.title: Will Texas legalize recreational marijuana before 2028?

markets.rules_primary: If legislation providing a $1,500 check to every Texas household is enacted in Texas before Jan 1, 2028, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
Enactment requires completion of all constitutional and legal requirements for the legislation to become binding law.

Standard legislation requiring executive approval: final passage by all required legislative bodies, executive signature OR becoming law despite executive inaction OR successful veto override, and satisfaction of any required waiting periods
Legislation not requiring executive approval: final passage and completion of required waiting periods
Constitutional amendments: passage with required supermajorities and completion of ratification processes
Executive orders: official signature, publication in official government records, and legal effectiveness

The following do NOT constitute enactment:

Legislative passage without completed executive action
Passage by only some required bodies
Provisional passage
Non-binding resolutions
Draft orders

Enactment occurs when all requirements are completed, regardless of pending judicial challenges.

For this market, legislation providing a $1,500 check to every Texas household means legislation that provides a one-time payment of at least $1,500 to each household in Texas, as in Gina Hinojosa's proposal. It may be funded from any source, paid by check or other direct payment, and use any legislative vehicle, including a state budget act. Application, verification, residency, citizenship or immigration-status requirements do not prevent it from counting. A law that is enacted but whose payments have not yet been issued counts.

Legislation that only provides property tax relief or tax credits, makes payments only to households limited by income, age or homeownership, appropriates money without providing the payments, provides the payments without money appropriated to pay them, or orders a study does NOT qualify.

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the specific individual leaves the role as defined in the payout criteria.
markets.rules_primary: If Kash Patel leaves (or announces they will leave) the Trump administration after Issuance and before Jan 1, 2028, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
This market resolves when the departure is publicly announced by the person, the President, the White House or their agency, regardless of the effective date. Only announcements after Issuance count, and unconfirmed reports from unnamed officials do not.

Leaving the Trump administration means no longer holding any executive branch position; the Federal Reserve and federal courts are not part of it. For military officers, retirement or removal from their post counts, but reassignment does not. Leaving one role does not count if a move to, or keeping, another administration position is announced at the same time or earlier, such as Deputy Attorney General to Attorney General or Deputy Chief of Staff to Chief of Staff; a position announced afterward does not change the outcome. A departure taking effect at the end of the term on Jan 20, 2029 does not count.

If the person dies in office, contracts on them may resolve to the last fair price as determined by the Exchange.

A departure taking effect at the end of the term on Jan 20, 2029 does not count.

If the person dies in office, contracts on them may resolve to the last fair price as determined by the Exchange.

markets.rules_primary: If the U.S. Department of Defense wins the trial-level resolution of Erik A. Slavin, Lara S. Korte, and Max D. Lederer, Jr. v. R. Sean Parnell, Andrew Brey, U.S. Department of Defense, and Peter B. Hegseth, No. 1:26-cv-03009 after Issuance and before Jan 1, 2028, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
Winning means achieving the superior outcome through the following exclusive hierarchy:

Net Monetary Recovery (Highest Priority): The U.S. Department of Defense achieves the superior outcome if it receives a larger net monetary award than all opposing parties combined (after offsetting any awards against it). Attorney's fees and costs are excluded.

Substantive Legal Victory (Second Priority): If no net monetary advantage exists for any party, the U.S. Department of Defense achieves the superior outcome if it prevails on claims seeking the largest dollar amount of relief in its original pleadings. If relief amounts are equal or unclear, it achieves the superior outcome if it prevails on the greater number of primary causes of action.

Case Termination Advantage (Third Priority): If the case terminates without substantive judgment, the U.S. Department of Defense achieves the superior outcome if all claims against it are dismissed with prejudice. All other termination scenarios result in no superior outcome for any party.

Settlements:
If parties settle with a disclosed net payment to the U.S. Department of Defense, it achieves the superior outcome.
If parties settle with a disclosed net payment from the U.S. Department of Defense to opposing parties, it does not achieve the superior outcome.
If parties settle with mutual releases and no disclosed payment direction, or if settlement terms are sealed and no Source Agency reports payment direction within 7 days of settlement announcement, no party achieves a superior outcome.

Key exclusions: This Contract applies ONLY to trial-level resolution and specifically excludes all appeals processes. Only claims directly involving the U.S. Department of Defense are considered; third-party claims, interpleader actions, and claims between other parties are excluded.

Injunctive relief counts as substantive victory only if it provides the primary relief sought in the original pleadings. A temporary restraining order, preliminary injunction, or denial of emergency relief alone is not the final trial-level resolution.

markets.rules_primary: If legislation that adds or widens a legal ground for abortion or removes criminal liability for abortion or for assisting one is enacted in Poland before Jan 1, 2028, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
Enactment requires completion of all constitutional and legal requirements for the legislation to become binding law.

Standard legislation requiring executive approval: final passage by all required legislative bodies, executive signature OR becoming law despite executive inaction OR successful veto override, and satisfaction of any required waiting periods
Legislation not requiring executive approval: final passage and completion of required waiting periods
Constitutional amendments: passage with required supermajorities and completion of ratification processes
Executive orders: official signature, publication in official government records, and legal effectiveness

The following do NOT constitute enactment:

Legislative passage without completed executive action
Passage by only some required bodies
Provisional passage
Non-binding resolutions
Draft orders

Enactment occurs when all requirements are completed, regardless of pending judicial challenges.

For this market, a law easing Poland's abortion ban means a statute of Poland that adds or widens a statutory ground on which abortion is legal, such as severe and irreversible fetal impairment or abortion on request, or that removes criminal liability, in whole or in part, for abortion or for assisting one. It may contain other provisions and need not legalise abortion on request.

Guidelines or regulations of the Ministry of Health, the National Prosecutor's Office or the National Health Fund, rulings of the Constitutional Tribunal or any court, and measures that only change hospital procedures, conscience-clause rules or funding without adding or widening a ground or removing criminal liability do NOT count. Passage by the Sejm or Senate alone, and a bill the President has vetoed or referred to the Constitutional Tribunal without the Sejm overriding or the President signing it, do NOT count.

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the specific individual leaves the role as defined in the payout criteria.
markets.rules_primary: If Mike Johnson leaves (or announces he will leave) as U.S. Representative before Jan 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
This market resolves based on when the departure is publicly announced or officially communicated, regardless of the effective date.

Giving up the Speakership or House Republican leadership alone does not count. A departure that takes effect at the end of a term, on Jan 3, 2027 or Jan 3, 2029, does not count, including a statement that Mike Johnson will not seek reelection in 2028 or will run for another office when his term ends.

If the person leaves the role due to death (i.e., if the person dies while holding the role), all contracts on the person may resolve to the last fair price as determined in the sole discretion of the Exchange. Temporary leaves of absence, suspensions, or recusals do not constitute leaving, resigning from, or retiring from the role unless the individual formally and permanently ceases to hold the position. If the person vacates the role and then re-occupies the role, the contract may settle on the initial vacation of the role.

For "leave," cessation of holding the role qualifies, including resignation, retirement, removal, expulsion, expiration of term without renewal, recall, or other means by which the individual no longer occupies the role. This includes both voluntary and involuntary early departure; a departure at the natural end of a term counts only as stated above.
markets.title: Will Mike Johnson announce their departure as U.S. Representative before Jan 1, 2027?

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the law is enacted
markets.rules_primary: If legislation conditioning or restricting the development, siting, or electric service of data centers above a defined size or load threshold (by moratorium, mandatory state or utility-regulator approval, or binding large-load cost-allocation requirements) and not merely a study, reporting, or tax-treatment measure is enacted in Maine before Jan 1, 2028, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
Enactment requires completion of all constitutional and legal requirements for the legislation to become binding law.

Standard legislation requiring executive approval: final passage by all required legislative bodies, executive signature OR becoming law despite executive inaction OR successful veto override, and satisfaction of any required waiting periods
Legislation not requiring executive approval: final passage and completion of required waiting periods
Constitutional amendments: passage with required supermajorities and completion of ratification processes
Executive orders: official signature, publication in official government records, and legal effectiveness

The following do NOT constitute enactment:

Legislative passage without completed executive action
Passage by only some required bodies
Provisional passage
Non-binding resolutions
Draft orders

Enactment occurs when all requirements are completed, regardless of pending judicial challenges.

Note: This event was issued before the September 14, 2026 amendment to the LAW Contract, so that amendment does not apply. To be clear, a law must take legal effect before this event’s deadline; a law enacted before the deadline whose effective date falls on or after it does not satisfy the Payout Criterion.

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the event described in the Payout Criterion occurs.
markets.rules_primary: If Venezuela agrees to or announces an OPEC exit before Jan 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
An announcement qualifies even if Venezuela's withdrawal will take effect later. Consideration, negotiations, a conditional proposal, an anonymous or leaked report, an opposition statement, or an OPEC+ policy change without an OPEC withdrawal does NOT qualify.

An agreement or announcement qualifies if it involves any of the following:

Formal signing of treaties, accords, or binding agreements
Parliamentary approval with binding effect
Official ratification
Formal commitment by the head of state/government with constitutional authority
Official statements by authorized ministers
Official press releases
Formal declarations during government proceedings
Official statements to international bodies

Phased implementation announcements and multi-party agreements where the country is a signatory also qualify.

The following do NOT qualify:

Preliminary discussions or expressions of interest without commitment
Conditional agreements contingent on circumstances
Opposition party statements
Leaked documents not confirmed by government sources
Think-tank recommendations
General aspirations without specific commitment
Draft legislation without approval
Regional actions
Retraction of previously announced commitments
